run_environment_command: run the EnvironmentCommand to collect and display system environment information for diffusers
register_env_subcommand: register the env subcommand parser for the diffusers CLI argument parser
collect_environment_info: collect environment info including PyTorch, Flax, Jax, and accelerator versions into a dictionary
format_dict_to_string: format a dictionary into a readable string with key-value pairs separated by newlines
detect_gpu_accelerator: detect GPU accelerator info using nvidia-smi on Linux or system_profiler on macOS
